findings.quoted_text: Client may terminate for convenience upon 20 days' written notice, subject to payment of fees for Services properly performed through the effective termination date. Contractor may terminate only for Client's material breach under Section 12.1.

findings.explanation: Only the client has the right to terminate the agreement without cause, leaving you bound to perform unless a breach occurs, even though your completed work will be paid.
findings.suggested_change: Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon 20 days' written notice, subject to payment for Services properly performed through the effective termination date.
